topic.title: Release notes for 0.4
topic.shortdesc: Offline packages of one reader's docs, a way back to the managed account from the admin console, and a help widget that works under a strict Content Security Policy.

ul.li: New command opend package writes one reader's docs as a static site that opens offline, as a zip file or a folder, optionally with their PDFs. Only what that reader may see goes in. See .
The admin console links back to the managed service's account panel: Your account in its header, and Back to your account in its menu on phones. See .

The help widget works in host apps whose Content Security Policy allows no inline styles (style-src 'self'): it styles its button and panel with constructable stylesheets. Before, the panel was blocked from being styled there. See .

section.title: Upgrading from 0.3
section.p: Deploy the new image. There are no new migrations. The new environment variable OPEND_ACCOUNT_URL is optional and set by a hosting provider; see .
